scope: Complete 32-second studio presentation, separate from the RGB dataset ribbon.
presentation: Exact saved task states replayed at 2x with staggered periodic case refreshes. Successful released endpoints are retained, followed by scripted kinematic arm return to home. Whole finite workcell groups fade in only while fully in frame and fade out before leaving it. Linear-light matched-layer compositing and white ground/shadow composite are presentation edits. This is not live generation or a throughput measurement; studio identity colors are not paper RGB randomization.
